title: Analytical Exposition
goals: memahami tujuan **analytical exposition**: meyakinkan pembaca bahwa suatu hal **memang demikian** (*is the case*)
memakai **simple present** dan kata kerja berpendapat: [[believe]], [[argue]], [[show]]
membedakan **fakta** dan **opini**, serta memakai bukti untuk mendukung argumen
menulis analytical exposition singkat yang runtut

lesson.text: Di unit sebelumnya kamu berpendapat secara lisan. **Analytical exposition** adalah teks tertulis yang **meyakinkan pembaca** dengan argumen yang tersusun rapi. Teks ini sering muncul sebagai opini di koran, esai sekolah, dan soal ujian.

lesson.title: 1. Struktur analytical exposition
table: alasan beserta bukti atau contoh (bisa lebih dari satu)
[[Firstly, phones help students find information quickly.]]
[[Therefore, schools should allow phones for learning.]]

lesson.title: Pola satu argumen
lesson.text: **Point** (poin) → **Elaboration** (penjelasan) → **Evidence** (bukti/contoh). Contoh: [[Firstly, reading improves vocabulary. Readers meet new words every day. For example, a student who reads daily learns many new words.]]

items.ex: The thesis is in the first paragraph.
Her first argument is about health.
Too much sugar can cause diabetes.

lesson.title: 4. Fakta dan opini
table: [[Plastic takes hundreds of years to decay.]]
[[Plastic is the worst problem in the world.]]
[[Plastic is harmful because it pollutes the sea.]]

lesson.title: Opini perlu bukti
lesson.text: Analytical exposition yang baik tidak hanya berkata [[I think it is bad.]] Tambahkan **alasan** dan **bukti** (fakta, data, contoh). Kata penilai seperti [[best]], [[worst]], [[boring]] adalah tanda opini.

lesson.title: Teks 1: Why We Should Read Every Day

lines.en: Reading is a habit that every student should have. It gives us knowledge, builds our imagination, and relaxes our mind.
lines.id: Membaca adalah kebiasaan yang seharusnya dimiliki setiap siswa. Membaca memberi kita pengetahuan, membangun imajinasi, dan menenangkan pikiran.

lines.en: Firstly, reading improves our vocabulary. Readers meet many new words in books, so they can speak and write better.
lines.id: Pertama, membaca meningkatkan kosakata. Pembaca bertemu banyak kata baru di buku sehingga mereka dapat berbicara dan menulis lebih baik.

lesson.text: 1) Tentukan **thesis** satu kalimat. 2) Tulis 2–3 **argumen** dengan bukti. 3) Hubungkan dengan kata penghubung. 4) Tutup dengan **reiteration** memakai [[In conclusion, ...]]. 5) Baca ulang: apakah tiap argumen mendukung thesis?

read.id:
Membaca adalah salah satu kebiasaan terbaik yang dapat dimiliki seorang siswa. Pertama, membaca meningkatkan kosakata. Siswa yang rutin membaca bertemu kata-kata baru dalam konteks dan memahami cara penggunaannya. Kedua, membaca meningkatkan konsentrasi. Tidak seperti video pendek, buku menuntut kita fokus dalam waktu lama.
Selain itu, penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pembaca memiliki imajinasi dan empati yang lebih baik. Karena itu, sekolah sebaiknya menyediakan waktu membaca lima belas menit setiap hari. Kesimpulannya, membaca setiap hari akan membantu siswa menjadi lebih cerdas dan lebih bijaksana.

qs.q: What does the writer recommend schools do?

read.text:
Reading is one of the best habits a student can have. Firstly, reading improves vocabulary. A student who reads regularly meets new words in context and understands how they are used. Secondly, reading increases concentration. Unlike short videos, books require us to focus for a long time.
Moreover, research shows that readers have better imagination and empathy. Therefore, schools should provide fifteen minutes of reading time every day. In conclusion, daily reading will help students become smarter and more thoughtful.
read.title: Reading Should Be a Daily Habit

Sebagian orang percaya bahwa PR harus dilarang karena membuat siswa stres. Saya tidak setuju dengan pandangan ini karena dua alasan.
Pertama-tama, PR membantu siswa berlatih apa yang telah dipelajari. Tanpa latihan, sulit mengingat pelajaran. Selain itu, PR mengajarkan tanggung jawab dan manajemen waktu. Karena alasan-alasan ini, saya yakin PR tidak boleh dilarang, tetapi guru sebaiknya memberi jumlah yang wajar.

read.text:
Some people believe that homework should be banned because it makes students stressed. I disagree with this view for two reasons.
To begin with, homework helps students practise what they have learned. Without practice, it is difficult to remember a lesson. In addition, homework teaches responsibility and time management. For these reasons, I believe homework should not be banned, but teachers should give a reasonable amount.
read.title: Should Homework Be Banned?

read.text:
The cost of living in cities has been rising for several years. Rents have increased by twenty percent, and food prices have been going up as well. Firstly, this makes it difficult for young workers to save money.
Moreover, many families have been spending most of their income on housing. Therefore, the government should control rental prices and build more affordable homes. In conclusion, if nothing is done, more people will struggle to meet their basic needs.
